reasoning: 16.1.3.1.1（PRE1.3.1.1）規定即使觸控音效關閉，儲存 preset 的確認音仍會播放。這是 RAD-047-01 的負向配對（§7）：同一動作、觸控音效設定相反。驗證需先確認觸控音效確實已關閉（按下其他控制項無觸控音），否則無法區分「設定未生效」與「本條成立」，故步驟包含一次對照操作。容器錨定：ch16 橫跨兩個容器——Playing Tab 上的 Mixed Presets Bank（PRE1.x）與 Browse Tab 內的 Browse Presets List（PRE2.x）。兩者的 preset 外觀相近、步驟前綴卻不同，故每一行 ER 都指名觀察所在的容器，tc_title 的 tag 亦帶容器名，避免 reviewer 與測試者誤判。 觀察於 Playing Tab 的 Mixed Presets Bank。優先級：屬設定交互的分支，訂 P2。

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本筆為觸控音效關閉的情況，與 RAD-047-01 的開啟情況構成正負配對

tcs.test_item:
The system shall play the confirmation sound when a preset is stored even if touch tone sounds are disabled.

(Touch tone sounds disabled, storing from the Playing Tab)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. FM is the active source on the HU
2. At least one preset slot is unset
3. Touch tone sounds are disabled on the HU
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Media" on Main Menu Bar to open the Media screen
2. Press "Playing" on the Tab Buttons to open the Playing Tab
3. Press "Browse" on the Tab Buttons and listen to the audio output of the HU
4. Press "Playing" on the Tab Buttons to return to the Playing Tab
5. Press the preset slot displaying a plus sign "+" in the Mixed Presets Bank and listen to the audio output of the HU
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Media screen is displayed and FM is the active source
2. The Playing Tab is displayed in the Tab Area
3. No touch tone is output from the HU speakers, confirming touch tone sounds are disabled
4. The Playing Tab is displayed in the Tab Area
5. A confirmation sound is output from the HU speakers
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
